reviews.text: Very kind and thoughtful. Helped my pooch straight away

After many years, I have sadly moved all of my pets to another vet. Abbey House has become too expensive - charging £30 for non-prescription items that are £7 online and sometimes adding them to your bill without consent. I do not want to pursue resolutions via complaints so have taken my business elsewhere.
Very friendly understood my needs for my cat and we're gentle with my cat I would recommend the vets to anyone thank you

I cannot express enough superlatives in this review to cover the care and attention pets receive with Abbey House Rothwell. We've been going there over 15 years with rodents and cats. Every pet is cared for as if it were their own, and as owners we are treated kindly and warmly. I've had to have pets put down before, and their kindness and compassion was endless. Their day to day care is exceptional. We will never use a different vet.
The staff at Rothwell are very welcoming and everyone greets my little pup and try to put him at ease

My dog rosie is always treated kindly and vets are really patient with her as she is very nervous also the staff are always polite, helpful and friendly the waiting room is clean and well organized I have been using them now for years with rosie and previous dogs and have no issues at all would definitely recommend
Great care and service l. Highly recommend this local vets
Always friendly, helpful and more often than not Gigi is seen before her appointment time.
